_comment: Hand edits applied on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Göteborg C (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py). A ground-level terminus: tracks 1–16 and the hall; the upper level is the walkway to Nils Ericson Terminalen. Tram and bus stops (A–D) are left out.

connections.note: OSM gap: the head of platform 1/2 isn't joined to the hall walkway.
OSM gap: the head of platform 3/4 isn't joined to the hall walkway.
OSM gap: the head of platform 5/6 isn't joined to the hall walkway.

sources.note: Laserdata Nedladdning, skog, © Lantmäteriet, bearbetad, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/740000002).
JNB 2027 Bilaga 2A and BanInfo Plattform: platform height classes (3D research pass; data/stations/research/trafikverket_platforms_SE.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (2026-10-19 extract) with 3 hand connections for gaps in OSM; see connections[].note.
Platform heights from Trafikverket's register; 32 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/740000002).
